# Personal Portfolio

A personal portfolio and writing site built with Jekyll and hosted on GitHub Pages. The layout takes inspiration from the concise portfolio structure at [yohandev.github.io](https://yohandev.github.io/): introduction, experience, selected projects, and an archive.

## Publish with GitHub Pages

This repository is named `toonpeters99.github.io`, so it is set up as an account site. In the repository on GitHub:

1. Open **Settings** and select **Pages**.
2. Under **Build and deployment**, choose **Deploy from a branch**.
3. Select the `main` branch and `/ (root)`, then save.
4. Wait for the Pages deployment to finish. The site will be available at `https://toonpeters99.github.io/`.

GitHub Pages builds the Jekyll files in this repository automatically. The root `index.html` is the entry page.

## Personalize the site

- Replace the sample name, introduction, experience, and project entries in `index.html`.
- Update the site title and description in `_config.yml`.
- Add social links or a portrait to the intro in `index.html` when you have those assets.
- Add a project under `_projects/` as `title.md` (no date in the filename) and set `date:` in its front matter.

The first article is based on the visible slide content in the linked Google Slides presentation and is published from `_projects/earplug-insert-holder.md`.
